description.text: This program is for the students who have difficulties in taking undergraduate courses directly. Enrollments are available in September during each academic year. The total duration of schooling is 1+4 years (1+5 years for Architecture and City Planning). The first year is for general Chinese courses, the second year is for advanced Chinese courses and a few specialized courses. Students can participate in the subject courses with Chinese students as sophomores.

duration.text: The Preparatory Classes and Bachelor's Programs at Kunming University of Science and Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1916 USD/per year ￥ 13800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above

requirements.text: High school diploma; Students should be in good healthy;
